up: Retrieve all activity records for the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1613842. For each activity record, provide the compound's ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id) and its preferred name, the standard activity type, the standard relation, the standard value, the standard units, and the pChEMBL value if available. Include all measurements without filtering on relation or units.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613842';
